html:
Question 5
?

The change-of-coordinates matrix from the basis C to the basis B is given by PC→B=[4−21−1]. Find the change-of-coordinates matrix from B to C.

a
[12−112−2]
b
[1−1212−2]
c
[−1−1212−2]
d
[1−112−2]
e
[−1−12−2−1]
Submit
